title: 20-Layer Chirped DBR with Deterministic Linear Chirp Seed
scientific_hypothesis: A 20-layer HfO2/SiO2 chirped dielectric stack initialized with explicit linear thickness gradients (odd layers: 45-90 nm ramp, even layers: 65-130 nm ramp) will achieve higher target scores than unseeded optimization by escaping local minima associated with periodic quarter-wave stacks.
design_principle: Chirped Bragg reflector with linearly varying optical thickness across the stack to broaden the high-reflectance band (400-700 nm) while maintaining a transmission window at 1530-1565 nm through destructive interference cancellation in the telecom band.
proposed_topology: Air | [HfO2 | SiO2]_10 | Fused Silica substrate (20 finite layers total, alternating high/low index starting with HfO2)
design_variables: Individual layer thicknesses (20 continuous variables, bounded 30-250 nm)
Initial thickness profile seeded with linear chirp
soft_objectives: Maximize average transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band
Maximize average reflectance in 400-700 nm band
Maintain total layer count at exactly 20
manufacturing_considerations: Individual layer thicknesses within typical ion-beam sputtering capability (30-250 nm)
No thickness coupling constraints to allow optimizer full freedom
theory_basis: Chirped DBR bandwidth broadening theory: varying layer optical thickness expands reflection band beyond periodic stack limit
Prior iteration_04 achieved 0.918 target score with 20-layer chirped design
expected_advantages: Deterministic initialization reduces optimizer dependence on random seed
Linear chirp profile explicitly targets broad visible reflection band
known_risks: Chirp profile may not be optimal for asymmetric dual-band requirement
Optimizer may still converge to local minima despite seeding
Thick end-layers may introduce absorption or scattering losses not modeled
execution_request_english: Optimize a 20-layer planar dielectric stack on fused silica substrate under normal incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2 (20 finite layers). Initialize thicknesses with deterministic linear chirp: odd-indexed layers (HfO2) ramp from 45 nm to 90 nm across the stack, even-indexed layers (SiO2) ramp from 65 nm to 130 nm. Optimization bounds: 30-250 nm per layer. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with increased perturbation magnitude (3x baseline) for first 3 generations. Score candidates by: (1) average transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band, (2) average reflectance in 400-700 nm band, with equal weighting. Wavelength sampling: 5 nm steps in both bands. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates, tightest_margin, and thicknesses_nm for all physically valid candidates. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1530-1565 nm, 400-700 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band; High reflectance in 400-700 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band; Low transmittance in 400-700 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count <= 30.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive for deterministic linear chirp seed initialization and increased early-generation perturbation to escape periodic basin. Maintains 20-layer count from best-performing iteration_04 (score 0.918) while adding explicit initialization protocol absent in prior runs.
